meaning: Setting DECK_CHOICE before the registry include makes EXPERIMENT strip to "jugular_compression", so the run picks up that experiment's protocol and target recordings rather than anything keyed to the "_m1_analysis" suffix. This fixes which patient traces the model output is compared against and which deck the figures land in.

could_move.what: Which deck the m1 jugular-compression figures are written to, and what is overlaid against patient data
Comparison pairings in the patient decks if the stripped EXPERIMENT selects different targets
Cross-model panels that assume the same experiment label on both sides
The verification against fit.jl's own trace that this ordering is meant to make checkable
Figures in the Fitting report (patient decks) and the CIS report jug-* figures

expectation: Unknown. The include order controls label stripping, so it could change deck routing and target selection, or be inert if the suffix is ignored downstream. I cannot tell which from this context.

check.why: Re-runs the fit.jl trace verification for Model_1 without a full re-fit, so a mismatch in what is compared with what should surface cheaply.
